tickets.subject: Sick Leave Policy for Medical Appointments

comments.body: Hi Elena, yes, you can use your sick leave for medical appointments as well as if you're unwell or need to care for a sick family member. Let me know if you have any other questions!

tickets.subject: How do we measure the impact of People Analytics Office Hours?

comments.body: Hi Elena, great question! We actually track a few things: one is whether we see fewer individual support requests coming in via email or Slack. And we also look at follow-up project requests that come out of the sessions, which we tag with 'PA-office-hours' in the project tracker. Let me know if you need more detail or links to any of these!

tickets.subject: Guidance on Starting Change Management for Upcoming Project
tickets.description: Hi team, I'm about to kick off a transformation project and want to make sure I'm following the right steps for change management. Is there a checklist or a recommended process I should be using to get started? Specifically, I'm not sure how to identify the key stakeholders and what kind of communication plan is expected. Any pointers or resources would be appreciated!

comments.body: Hi Elena, great question! For getting started with change management, we recommend first figuring out what stage your project is in, who your main stakeholders are, and what the biggest risks might be. Then, you’ll want to draft a From→To→Because statement, list your top 5 stakeholders, pick an exec sponsor, and decide how you’ll communicate updates. After that, it’s about building support—meeting with your sponsor, finding change champions, and setting up feedback loops. Let me know if you want more details or if you’d like to connect with Learning & Development for a deeper dive!

Let me know if you need the direct link or have any other questions!

tickets.subject: Panel interview process clarification
tickets.description: Hi People Ops, I’m prepping for a panel interview next week and just wanted to double check—are we supposed to do these over video, or is it okay to have the candidate come in person? Also, is there a specific way we should kick things off with the candidate, like intros or explaining the format? Thanks!

comments.body: Hi Sam, great questions! We actually recommend doing panel interviews by video call, since it tends to be less intimidating for candidates and keeps things more conversational. At the start, it’s best to introduce everyone on the panel and give the candidate a quick overview of how the interview will go—timing, what to expect, that sort of thing. Let me know if you need more details or have other questions!

tickets.subject: How do I apply for an internal job opening?
tickets.description: Hi People Ops, I saw a couple of roles posted that I’m interested in moving to internally. Can you walk me through how I’m supposed to apply as a current employee? Do I just use the regular jobs page or is there a different process for team members?

comments.body: Hi Chloe! Great question. As a current team member, you’ll want to use the internal job board instead of the public jobs page. You can get to it by logging into your Greenhouse account (if you haven’t set that up yet, just click the Greenhouse tile in Okta to activate it). Once you’re in, there’s a link to the internal job board under Helpful Links, or you can go straight to the internal board from your dashboard. From there, just click on the job title you’re interested in and hit Apply. Let me know if you need more details or run into any issues!
